event: Nala takes a spine quill in each hand, holding each by its blunt root, and crouches low.

changes.note: Nala takes up two of the five laid-out quills
Nala holds a spine quill in each hand by its root

event: She keeps her eyes moving between the grass to the south and the bird overhead.
The bird is broad-winged, its pale wing edges glittering; it only circles, high and patient.

memory.fact: A carrion hawk is broad-winged, and the pale edges of its wings glitter as it turns.
A carrion hawk is broad-winged, and the pale edges of its wings glitter as it turns.

event: The beast comes out of the grass at the far side of the kill and stops, snout lifted.
It is thigh-high, heavy through the shoulders, its back a thick mat of pale quills.

memory.fact: A grown shardback is thigh-high, heavy through the shoulders, its back a thick mat of pale quills.
A grown shardback is thigh-high, heavy through the shoulders, its back a thick mat of pale quills.

event: It looks at the carcass, then at her, crouched low and bleeding beside it.
It does not rattle. It does not circle. It puts its head down and comes straight at her.
She drives the right-hand quill at its face as it reaches her.
Its eyes are small, sunk deep under a ridge of short brow quills, and she cannot find them.

memory.fact: A shardback's eyes are small and deep-set under a ridge of short brow quills, hard to reach.
A shardback's eyes are small and deep-set under a ridge of short brow quills, hard to reach.

event: The quill glances off the hard brow and snaps in her fist.

changes.note: The right-hand quill glances off the brow and snaps

event: The jaws close on her other ankle, the good one, and bite down hard.

changes.note: The grown shardback's jaws close hard on her good ankle: 48

event: It hangs on and twists, and it is heavier than the first; it drags her half off balance.
One foot torn at the calf and the other held in its jaws, she has nothing left to stand on.
It wrenches again, harder, and she feels herself start to go over.

memory.fact: A grown shardback has its jaws locked on Nala's good ankle, twisting and dragging her over.
